name: nl.nltaxcalculator/salary-tr
title: Turkey Salary and Income Tax Calculator
description: Turkey 2026: tax return estimate, net salary, gross for net, employer cost, vs the Netherlands

tools.name: net_salary
tools.description: Take-home pay for an employee in Turkey from a gross yearly salary in TRY, with 2026 rules: every tax and contribution itemised with its local name, the effective and marginal rate, employer cost and the step-by-step workings. Covers: 2026 wage brackets applied month by month on cumulative income; Minimum-wage exemption from income and stamp tax; SGK and unemployment up to 9× the minimum wage; BES private pension, employer SGK with or without the incentive.

tax_year.description: Tax year. Offered: 2026 (final), 2025 (final). Default 2026. A year that is not listed is not available for this country.

tools.name: tax_rules_covered
tools.description: The Turkey rules the calculators apply (2026), the options they take, what is not modelled, and the official sources, for the salary calculators and the full income tax return. Call it before answering a question the other tools may not cover.

tools.name: income_tax_return
tools.description: The complete Turkey income tax computation for 2026, as on the return. Covers: Wages per employer: SGK and unemployment with the 9× ceiling, insurance premiums, disability allowance, wage tariff, minimum-wage exemption, stamp duty; When wages must be declared (several employers, ₺400,000 and ₺5,300,000 tests) and the 75 Seri No. Sirküler wage split; Rental income: ₺58,000 housing exemption and its limits, lump-sum 15% vs actual expenses (both computed), workplace rent withholding; Investment income: deposit withholding, dividends half exempt with the ₺400,000 test, unwithheld income over ₺22,000; and more. Returns the tax, the balance still to pay or to be refunded after taxes already paid, every option the law offers compared, and each step with its legal reference. All amounts in TRY; everything is optional, give only what applies. What is not modelled is listed in the result.

tools.name: cross_border_year
tools.description: Estimates the employment income tax in BOTH countries for the tax year in which someone moves from one country to another: residency status in each country by its own rules (India's 182-day financial-year test, US substantial presence and dual-status, UK split year, Dutch migration year, German part-year liability), the income each country taxes, tax before and after relief for tax paid abroad, social contributions, the combined total in euros and a comparison with staying. Covers 19 countries; each country is taxed for its own tax year containing the move date. Returns what is not covered, assumptions, and for researched corridors (India with the Netherlands, US, UK or Germany; Netherlands with Germany or the UK) the forms and deadlines, treaty notes and official sources. Salaries are full-year rates in each country's own currency.
